svg.title: IBM Envizi, counted in Accounts
svg.desc: Three IBM Envizi bundles, each counted in Accounts, the units that track different types of activity data, supplier data and performance KPIs: Essentials, up to 1,000 Accounts; Standard, 1,001 to 5,000; Premium, 5,001 to 15,000 and more. IBM's estimates assume a minimum term of 12 months.
